agencyName: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
authorityRationale: Official TDLR announcement (dated 2026-06-04/06-05) explicitly stating the Ohio agreement covers master electricians and master electrical contractors only: 'This agreement will allow licensed master electricians and master electrical contractors to work in either state.' Journeyman is NOT mentioned in this announcement — per Phase 2F.1, Ohio-Journeyman reciprocity is explicitly UNKNOWN, not confirmed and not denied.
reliabilityRationale: Direct official TDLR announcement — explicit about Master, silent on Journeyman, which is exactly why Journeyman must remain Unknown rather than inferred either way.
